relevance.rationale: Studies incomplete hyperbolic structures on the figure-eight knot complement. The deformations are parametrised by an open subset of a plane affine curve C of degree four with two ordinary double points, hence of genus one; the paper gives an explicit birational map from C to a nonsingular Weierstrass cubic E defined over Q, and exhibits a concrete correspondence between the closed 3-manifolds arising from degenerations (Sol-manifolds, Haken manifolds decomposing along an embedded torus, Euclidean orbifolds) and points of finite order on E, with the Haken cases corresponding exactly to the rational points, which form a cyclic group of order four. This is a genuinely arithmetic structure on the deformation space of the corpus's single most-used hyperbolic knot -- the figure-eight is the Higgs entry in the fundamental-knots table and the muon anchor Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 in the mass formula. Blocks such as prop:cusp-shape-bar-parity and prop:figure-eight-reeb-rotation work with that complement's cusp and deformation data with no arithmetic classification available to them. It is supporting, not core: no corpus claim depends on the degeneration classification today, and the corpus's own elliptic curve (the Descartes curve) is a different object, so the connection must be established rather than assumed. Its likely value is as a prune -- an enumeration of what the figure-eight deformation space can degenerate to, bounded by a torsion group of order four, is the kind of finite structural constraint that narrows a search before it is run.

keyResults.locator: Sec. 1 (Introduction), with the curve C at (1)-(2) and the Weierstrass model E at (4)
keyResults.statement: The deformation curve of incomplete hyperbolic structures on the figure-eight knot complement has genus one and is birational to an elliptic curve E over Q; degenerations correspond to points of finite order on E, and the Haken cases correspond exactly to the rational points of E, a cyclic group of order four.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies a finite arithmetic classification of what the corpus's muon-anchor knot complement can degenerate to, which bounds any attempt to deform that anchor and gives the cusp/Reeb blocks an arithmetic handle they currently lack.

proposedActions.rationale: The figure-eight complement is the corpus's most-used hyperbolic object and its deformation space has an explicit arithmetic classification that the corpus does not cite anywhere.
